concerns.text: T104 verification demands '≥9 KS records (3 metrics × mass bins)', but FR-008 defines KS tests between low vs. high ENVIRONMENT bins, and results.schema.yaml's bin_comparison enum only allows 'low_vs_high'/'mass_correlation'. As written, T104's own verification cannot be satisfied without violating the schema or contradicting FR-008. Fix the verification to match the spec's test design (3 metrics × environment bins, or per-mass-bin environment comparisons with a schema-compatible representation).

T105 mandates appending a 'bullock_comparison' record (RMSE, mean difference, per-bin residuals) to results/statistics.json, but the results schema has additionalProperties: false and no Bullock-comparison test_type/bin_comparison values — the mandated artifact would fail the schema validation T104 simultaneously requires. Either write the Bullock block to a separate artifact or extend the contract first.

T101 instructs loading 'code/contracts/raw_halo.schema.yaml', but no such contract exists — plan.md and data-model.md list only halo.schema.yaml and results.schema.yaml. The task's verification will fail on a missing schema file; point it at the existing halo.schema.yaml (or create the contract explicitly).

The spec edge case 'catalog missing a required column (e.g., velocities) → halt execution with explicit error message' has no implementing task. T107 covers only the 300-particle boundary, failed NFW fits, and KDE fallback. Add a task/test for the halt-on-missing-column behavior.

The spec assumption promising a sensitivity analysis sweeping the overdensity threshold and reporting classification-rate variation has no corresponding task in any phase. Either add a task or the assumption is silently dropped.

FR-005 mandates total energy via 'direct summation approximation of potential energy', but T023/T109 implement/document a 'Subsampled Plummer-Softened Potential' (N=500). The substitution is justified in the plan's complexity table but never recorded in spec.md — a retroactive narrowing of an FR. Update spec.md FR-005 to explicitly sanction the subsampled Plummer-softened summation, or the task weakens the requirement.

Add the pre-registered threshold constant to a task (T104 or T004-adjacent).
